question: In Melanoma Phase 2 trials, standardize the primary endpoint into one of OS, PFS, ORR, DFS, DOR, AE-rate, or Other.

steps.desc: Filter Melanoma Phase 2 trials and select primary endpoint.
Map free text to controlled primary endpoint categories.
steps.prompt: For each row, read Primary endpoint and output JSON {NCT, PMID, primary_endpoint_category}. Allowed primary_endpoint_category: ["OS", "PFS", "ORR", "DFS", "DOR", "AE-rate", "Other"]. Heuristics: OS if overall survival; PFS if progression-free survival; ORR if objective response rate; DFS if disease-free survival; DOR if duration of response; AE-rate if adverse event rate. JSON only.
